text:
anna: Heads-up: SAST and DAST jobs started failing with KMS decrypt errors after the key rotation this morning. CI shows PermissionDenied but with a weird note about a condition. anyone seen this?

ryan: Yep, saw it. Build output includes: PermissionDenied (condition not met) when calling KMS.decrypt for projects/rdw-prod/.../sensitive-key.

scanner-bot: job:sast-4211 -> ERROR PermissionDenied: projects/rdw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/sensitive-key: decrypt denied for serviceAccount:ci-scanner@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com (binding has condition)

tim: I deployed a constrained IAM binding yesterday to scope decrypt to requests from VMs with attribute region=="us-central1" (PR #4982). We thought Cloud Build would carry the attribute, but apparently it doesn't for this SA.

anna: Oof. That explains it. This is higher risk than a group drift because it silently stops decrypts for some pipelines.

sec-oncall: Opening incident channel #inc-341234-kms-conditional. Immediate mitigation: remove the conditional from the keystore binding (rollback) and re-run failing jobs. Then we'll craft a safer guardrail.

infra-logs: Audit entry found: ts=3412349950 actor=security-admin@redwood-inference updated KMS key IAM with condition expression: "resource.attributes.region == 'us-central1'". Log ref: projects/rdw-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity/entries/cond789. Retention=30d.

claire: Short-term fix applied by sec-oncall. Re-running jobs now. Longer-term: we need a checklist for any conditional IAM on keystore, plus a CI presubmit that simulates condition checks for scanner SAs.

ryan: Agreed. Action items: 1) add presubmit test that attempts a dry-run decrypt with the SA in a condition-less env, 2) inventory all conditional bindings and owner-approve them, 3) extend audit retention for keystore IAM events and add an alert when bindings use conditions.

anna: I'll write the incident RFC and include the rollback timeline and affected job list. Also will tag findings produced during the window as "condition-gap" for owners to re-verify.

sec-oncall: Triage complete. Marking incident resolved after rollback and backfill. RFC + runbook updates to follow. :white_check_mark:
